notes: LOI on 21 March 2023; time of day not published (12:00 UTC assumed)

Landing sequence from 100 km starting about 15:40 UTC, touchdown scheduled 16:40 UTC (ispace)

PDI altitude and duration, and the southbound ground track, are assumptions
